description: This PHP class defines an entity for a job specification attachment used in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for attachment metadata such as filename, file type, size, content, and an association to a JobTitle entity. The class integrates Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and uses a decorator trait to possibly enhance functionality.

classes.name: JobSpecificationAttachment
classes.description: Entity representing a file attachment for a job specification, including metadata and a relationship to a JobTitle entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: setFileSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the binary content of the file.

methods.name: setFileContent
methods.description: Sets the binary content of the file.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Associates a JobTitle entity with this attachment.
